{{Top|leg}}
'''Trell leather''' was a material made from the hides of [[Trell]]s, an animal native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bovo Yagen (planet)|Bovo Yagen]]. After the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] saved the [[Bovo Yagen system/Legends|Bovo Yagen system]] during the [[Corellian Crisis]], the native [[Bovorian]]s presented [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] made of Trell [[Leather/Legends|leather]] to their rescuers.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
